column1: # Fields dcgm-exporter should publish. Deliberately minimal.
# The DCGM_FI_PROF_* fields use the profiling engine
# container (granted in docker-compose.yml) and a DCGM build that matches the driver.
# Make sure there's no comma in the help string

column3: Fraction of time any kernel was resident (%). Coarse - reads near 100 during decode regardless of how well the SMs are fed.
Power draw (W). The L4 caps at 72W so this pinning is the first sign of clock throttling.
Fraction of cycles the DRAM interface is active.
Fraction of cycles at least one warp is resident. Real occupancy unlike GPU_UTIL - pairs with DRAM_ACTIVE for the compute-vs-bandwidth call.
